about: Anything on a standard 5 V ARGB (3-pin) header. The LED count isn't known, so the setup guide lights LEDs one by one until you see the end of the strip or the last fan.

items.name: ARGB fans
items.hint: One fan or several chained together

items.name: LED strip
items.hint: Strips, light bars and cable combs

items.name: Cooler or pump ring
items.hint: An RGB ring on a CPU cooler or AIO pump

items.name: Something else
items.hint: Lit case parts, GPU brackets, anything with ARGB
